# Distinct Fresh Final Checkpoint C: Two Actual Closed Original Targets

This is an independent read-only review of the completed Lean 4 kernel formalizations, audit receipts, and external mathematical bindings for two original targets:
1. **Target 1: Graph (54, 3)** with $n = 56862$ vertices ([`F9Graph56862Exact.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Exact.lean)).
2. **Target 2: Graph (55, 3)** with $n = 56943$ vertices ([`F9PlaneClone55Exact.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Exact.lean)).

---

## Explicit Verdicts

- **Graph (54, 3) $n = 56862$:** **PASS**
- **Graph (55, 3) $n = 56943$:** **PASS**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The verdict for Clone (55, 3) is **not inferred** from the source (54, 3) verdict. Clone 55 is evaluated on its own four dedicated Lean modules, its unconditional kernel load bound, its independent audit print receipt, and its own external edge-binding receipts.

---

## Target 1: Graph (54, 3) $n = 56862$ Technical Inspection

### 1. Kernel Theorem and Axiom Footprint
In [`F9Graph56862Exact.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Exact.lean#L7-L15), the target theorem [`concrete_order_degree_and_exact_D3`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Exact.lean#L7-L10) proves:
```lean
Fintype.card (Fin 56862) = 56862 ∧ (∀ v, graph.degree v ≤ 54) ∧
  DiameterAtMost graph 3 ∧ ¬DiameterAtMost graph 2
```
Additionally, [`concrete_regular_and_exact_D3`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Exact.lean#L12-L15) closes exact 54-regularity (`∀ v, graph.degree v = 54`), and [`final_claim`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Exact.lean#L11) matches `FinalClaim` unconditionally. 

As confirmed in [`F9Graph56862Audit.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/formalization/F9Graph56862Audit.log#L67-L75) and [`FINAL_COMPILE_RESULT.json`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/formalization/FINAL_COMPILE_RESULT.json#L11-L15):
- Axiom dependency across all targets is strictly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- There are **zero user certificate premises**, zero custom axioms, zero `sorryAx`, and zero unverified `native_decide` axioms.

### 2. Algebraic and Structural Formulation
- **Field & Carrier:** In [`F9Graph56862Field.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Field.lean), $\mathbb{F}_9$ is implemented as a 9-element inductive ring matching $\mathbb{F}_3[w]/(w^2+1)$ with code $a + 3b$. In [`F9Graph56862.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862.lean), the carrier is `Fin 56862` decomposed as controller $u \in \text{Fin } 78$ and fiber $x \in \text{Fin } 729$ via label $729u + x_0 + 9x_1 + 81x_2$.
- **Controller & Dart Charts:** A 78-vertex 6-regular Schreier controller with generators $(2,6,17,5,10)$ uses 8 distinct affine charts with true-inverse matrices. The reverse port involution uses noise $-t$ in characteristic 3.
- **Nonadjacent/Same Pairs (5616 pairs):** Covered in [`F9Graph56862Certificates.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Certificates.lean) through 169 linear models and 507 basis identities partitioned across 13 model chunks and 6 pair chunks. [`F9Graph56862ModelBridge.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862ModelBridge.lean) identifies route noise with model noise, and [`additive_ext`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Field.lean#L256-L263) extends basis validity to all noise vectors.
- **Adjacent Pairs (468 pairs):** Checked in [`F9Graph56862Adjacent.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Adjacent.lean) across 8 charts $\times$ 729 offsets (5832 offset checks in 24 block modules), using exact backtracking cancellation ($q$ and $q^{-1}$) to preserve the affine center.

### 3. Walk Construction, Degree, and Lower Bound
- **Actual Walk Construction:** In [`F9Graph56862Routes.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Routes.lean#L89-L101), [`bounded_walk_of_route`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Routes.lean#L94-L101) directly constructs an existential [`SimpleGraph.Walk`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Routes.lean#L89-L92) via three consecutive `Walk.cons (forward_adj _ _ _)`. No fiber-translation automorphism is assumed.
- **Regularity & Degree 54:** In [`F9Graph56862Degree.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Degree.lean#L9-L22), [`forward_parameters_injective`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Degree.lean#L9-L18) proves that forward parameter pairs $(p, t) \in \text{Fin } 6 \times \mathbb{F}_9$ are injective using controller-port injectivity and direction-noise injectivity, resolved cleanly with `Prod.ext rfl`. Thus every vertex has degree exactly 54.
- **Non-D2 Lower Bound:** In [`F9Graph56862Lower.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Lower.lean#L21-L37), vertices `0` and `729` (controller 0 and controller 1) serve as an existential witness. Kernel evaluation proves no 1-step or 2-step controller path connects 0 and 1, establishing $\neg\text{DiameterAtMost graph } 2$ on genuine `SimpleGraph.Walk` instances without any synthetic Moore predicates.

### 4. External Binding and Scope Boundaries
[`INPUT_BINDING_CHECK.json`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/formalization/INPUT_BINDING_CHECK.json) binds all 468 controller entries, 468 dart charts, 72 matrix entries, and 18 direction entries against the external generator. The external acceptance packet binds all 1,535,274 literal edges and verifies degree 54. External BFS verification was executed on 806 literal roots (all 729 roots in fiber 0 plus coordinate 0 in controllers 1–77), matching predicted distance profiles. The formal Lean proof reads 0 large edgefiles and claims all-pair diameter $D=3$ purely from the verified finite decoder chunks and linear model bridge.

All 68 closure modules and 1 retained raw-row pilot compile with exit code 0. Measured total CPU across all attempts (including 9 retained failures) is 890.286 CPU seconds, well within the 1500 CPU limit.

---

## Target 2: Graph (55, 3) $n = 56943$ Technical Inspection

### 1. Kernel Theorem and Axiom Footprint
In [`F9PlaneClone55Exact.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Exact.lean#L29-L35), the target theorem [`concrete_order_degree_and_exact_D3`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Exact.lean#L29-L32) proves:
```lean
Fintype.card Vertex = 56943 ∧ (∀ v, graph.degree v ≤ 55) ∧
  DiameterAtMost graph 3 ∧ ¬DiameterAtMost graph 2
```
[`final_claim`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Exact.lean#L34) matches `FinalClaim` unconditionally. 

As recorded in [`F9PlaneClone55Audit.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/single_fiber_plane55_graph/formalization/F9PlaneClone55Audit.log#L64-L68) and [`FINAL_COMPILE_RESULT.json`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/single_fiber_plane55_graph/formalization/FINAL_COMPILE_RESULT.json#L21-L25):
- The proof depends strictly on standard core axioms: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- No user certificate premises, no custom axioms, and no `native_decide` axioms exist in the closed theorem.
- The theorem directly imports the closed source 54 exact module without modifying or recompiling any source 54 code.

### 2. Carrier, Affine Centers, and Neighborhood Cloning
- **Carrier & Labeling:** In [`F9PlaneClone55Definitions.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Definitions.lean#L10-L27), vertices are defined as `Vertex := Fin 56862 ⊕ Fin 81`. The bijection [`label : Vertex ≃ Fin 56943`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Definitions.lean#L22) preserves old indices ($v \mapsto v$) and maps clone indices $j \mapsto 56862 + j$.
- **Plane Centers:** The 81 clone centers are situated in controller fiber 0 at $j = 9a + b$ with affine coordinates $(a, b, c_4 \cdot a)$. Crucially, $c_4 = 1 + w \in \mathbb{F}_9$ (`F.c4`) is the field element representing the non-square normal coordinate, **not** the integer 4.
- **Edge Relation:** The graph is defined via [`FullNeighborhoodClones.graph`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/FullNeighborhoodClones.lean#L8-L26). Each clone vertex $j$ connects strictly to the 54 immutable source neighbors of its center vertex. There are exactly zero new-new edges.

### 3. Unconditional Kernel Proof of $\text{load} \le 1$
In [`F9PlaneClone55Inputs.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Inputs.lean), the load bound is proved inside the Lean kernel without an external certificate premise:
1. Six explicit $3 \times 3$ inverse matrices are supplied in `pinInverse`.
2. [`pinInverse_basis`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Inputs.lean#L25-L26) verifies 18 basis identities (`act (pinInverse p) (pinMap p (basisVec j)) = basisVec j`) using kernel computation (`decide +kernel`).
3. [`additive_ext`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Field.lean#L256-L263) extends this linearly to all vectors in [`pinInverse_left`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Inputs.lean#L28-L33), proving that `pinMap p` is injective.
4. Along with controller-0 injectivity (`controller_zero_injective`), [`common_pin_index_unique`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Inputs.lean#L61-L74) establishes that no old vertex can be adjacent to two distinct clone centers ($Adj(w, center(i)) \wedge Adj(w, center(j)) \implies i = j$).
5. Consequently, [`load_le_one`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Inputs.lean#L75-L79) establishes `load G center w ≤ 1` unconditionally.

### 4. Generic Walk Lifting and Degree Bounds
In [`FullNeighborhoodClones.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/FullNeighborhoodClones.lean):
- [`degree_le`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/FullNeighborhoodClones.lean#L156-L162) combines the source degree bound $\le 54$ with `load ≤ 1` to conclude $\text{degree } u \le 55$ for all vertices.
- [`diameterAtMost`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/FullNeighborhoodClones.lean#L86-L104) lifts source walks of length $\ge 2$ via [`lift_both`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/FullNeighborhoodClones.lean#L75-L84) ensuring all internal vertices remain old, while handling length 0 and 1 cases constructively via [`source_no_isolated`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Exact.lean#L9-L10) (which witnesses `forward v 0 F.c0` via `forward_adj`).
- [`not_diameterAtMost`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/FullNeighborhoodClones.lean#L105-L112) transfers the lower bound $\neg\text{DiameterAtMost } 2$ via `old_walk_bound_iff` through the graph homomorphism `collapseHom`.

### 5. Audit Printout and External Binding
In [`F9PlaneClone55Audit.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/single_fiber_plane55_graph/formalization/F9PlaneClone55Audit.log#L69-L150), `#eval` with `eval.pp false` explicitly outputs all 81 ordered triplets `[i, center(i), label(.inr i)]`. [`INPUT_BINDING_CHECK.json`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/single_fiber_plane55_graph/formalization/INPUT_BINDING_CHECK.json) binds all 81 evaluated entries against the external generator. The external acceptance summary confirms all 1,539,648 literal edges (1,535,274 source edges + 4,374 pin edges + 0 new-new edges) and reports that BFS on each of the 81 new clone roots matches the predicted $(1, 54, 2477, 54411)$ distance histogram with 0 old-root re-evaluations.

All 4 new modules exit 0. Total measured CPU across all attempts (including 2 initial failures retained in build history) is 17.373 CPU seconds, well within the 300 CPU ceiling.

---

## Public Baseline and Scope Certification

- **Degree 54:** Best-located public guarantee of 55350 is exceeded by +1512 vertices (56862).
- **Degree 55:** Best-located public guarantee of 56375 is exceeded by +568 vertices (56943).
- **Certification Boundaries:** Global record status and historical priority remain uncertified. External literal BFS checks (806 roots for 54, 81 roots for 55) provide independent numeric corroboration without contaminating the Lean kernel proofs, which deduce diameter bounds unconditionally from algebraic and combinatorial theorems.

Both original targets are fully closed, soundly audited, and independently verified.
